title: onggi.updateplan.v1
description: A binding's answer to a switch plan (ADR-0010 plan): the device units to rewrite, or a full reload. Produced without device side effects.

mode.description: units: rewrite only the listed units; reload: load the target whole

reason.description: why a reload was chosen (fragmented, base not resident, unmappable, ...)

bytes.description: bytes the update writes to the device (an estimate for reload)

units.description: mode units: device units (rows, tensors, pages) in artifact byte space; together they cover every byte of the switch plan that is not same. Empty for reload.

unit.description: the name the binding gives the device unit (opaque to onggi)

source.description: where the bytes come from: the verified target files, or a device-side copy from the base
